आढकः, -कम्
 A measure of grain, the 4th of a Droṇa = 4 Prasthas^1 = 16
 Kuḍavas (= nearly 7 lbs. 11 ozs. avoir.); अष्टमुष्टिर्भवेत् कुञ्चिः कुञ्चयोऽष्टौ
 तु पुष्कलम् । पुष्कलानि च चत्वारि आढकः परिकीर्तितः ॥
[1] Correction submitted by Scott Rhodes on 20251211. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/102.

A kind of fragrant earth (Mar. गोपीचंदन).

आढकिक, आढकीन a. [cf. आचितिक] Holding an Āḍhaka,
 sown with an Āḍhaka of seed; cooking an Āḍhaka (of rice &c.).
